summary.headline: Florentine Astrological Codex Contents
summary.text: Catalog entries for Florentine codices 4 and 5, listing Porphyry’s introduction to Ptolemy’s Apotelesmatica, Ptolemy’s Fructus, an anonymous commentary, the Tetrabiblos and its explanation, anonymous astrological works, a Proclus excerpt on the Timaeus, Maximus, Manetho, John of Damascus, and Orpheus on earthquakes, with folio references and editions.
